rationale: The round-2 exchange has clarified the economic test and introduced an expert validation, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state still reject closures/compulsory redundancies while management, owners, and investors insist on closure-equivalent structural savings. Positions are now better defined and increasingly stable, so further open-ended bargaining is likely to circle unless an external fact-finding or scenario-quantification intervention narrows the gap.
